# obot_current_user (Data Source)

Reads the Obot user authenticated by the provider's API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "obot_current_user" "current" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `email` (String) The authenticated user's email address.
- `id` (String) The Obot user identifier.
- `username` (String) The authenticated user's Obot username.
